$comment: What people actually ask for. Phrasings are deliberate and must not be
reworded to make a sweep pass: the corpus represents requests, and a
request that fails is the finding. If a phrasing is retired, say why in
the commit rather than editing it into one that works.
`melodic-cvfunk` is the user's own words, from the request that failed
on M5 and started this. It stays exactly as they typed it.
Spread is across the shapes a request takes, not across idioms: several
of these deliberately name no idiom at all, because a request nobody
anticipated is the common case and must degrade to less help rather

prompts.prompt: simple highly melodic patch using only CV funk modules
a squelchy acid bassline with resonance and glide
a generative patch that never repeats
a bell tone with a long tail
a metallic FM timbre that moves
stepped random voltages driving a filter
something that sounds like rain on a window
